questions.q: In the decimal scale, the first potency (1X) has a drug-to-vehicle ratio of:
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. One part drug to nine parts vehicle.

questions.q: A sharp visceral pleural line with no lung markings beyond it on a chest X-ray indicates:
questions.why: Air in the pleural space separates the visceral pleura from the chest wall, leaving a hyperlucent area without lung markings.

questions.q: Which hormone is secreted by the posterior pituitary?
questions.why: Oxytocin and ADH are made in the hypothalamus and released from the posterior pituitary.

questions.q: The usual HbA1c target for most adults with diabetes is below:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Targets are individualised; 7% suits most adults.

questions.q: The normal tidal volume of an adult at rest is about:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. About 150 mL of it is anatomical dead space.
